original_hook: A phone displaying a talking pigeon filter video is held near a sleeping person's head.
original_trend_mechanic: Using funny or surreal audio filter videos to wake up sleeping friends.
adaptation_idea: King Robert is sleeping peacefully on his throne when a mischievous royal parrot plays a loud, funny sound right in his ear. Players must quickly solve a match-3 puzzle to silence the sound and help King Robert wake up safely.
royal_match_adaptation: King Robert is sleeping peacefully on his throne when a mischievous royal parrot plays a loud, funny sound right in his ear. Players must quickly solve a match-3 puzzle to silence the sound and help King Robert wake up safely.
opening_hook: A smartphone screen shows a talking pigeon filter image moving closer to a person sleeping in bed.
problem: A sudden castle danger threatens King Robert.
player_intervention: Player solves a rapid match-3 move to rescue King Robert.
payoff: Danger is resolved and King Robert safely celebrates.
king_robert_role: Main character in danger, then rescued by player intervention.
visual_style: Bright polished stylized 3D mobile game ad aesthetic.
